title: Preface — why Romans is hardest
english: Romans is reckoned harder than Paul’s other letters for two reasons: tangled phrasing, and many questions — especially those heretics twist to deny free purpose and blame [[diversity of nature >> Bible:Romans 9:11-21]]. We ask the God who [[teaches man knowledge >> Bible:Psalm 94:10]] and gives [[a word of wisdom by the Spirit >> Bible:1 Corinthians 12:8]] before we open the letter.

title: Paulus servus Jesu Christi — servant and son
english: [[Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ >> Bible:Romans 1:1]] — yet he also wrote [[you received a spirit of adoption >> Bible:Romans 8:15]]. Free from all, he [[made himself a servant to all >> Bible:1 Corinthians 9:19]], imitating the Lord who [[took the form of a servant >> Bible:Philippians 2:7]]. Slavery to Christ outranks every liberty. Glory to Christ. Amen.
